description: Track an account's new followers: platform (x, bluesky or github; instagram is not trackable yet) and handle (with or without @, a profile link works). The first read is a baseline (existing followers, never billed); from then on each new follower is billed at $0.008 and announced as a followers.new account event. Optional groupId (list_groups) and cap ({ followers: N } a month). Costs $2 a month: confirm with the user first. Needs a workspace that has topped up at least once (funding_required otherwise).

anyOf.description: A monthly cap on billed new followers.

followers.description: New followers billed in a UTC calendar month at most; past it the account stops being read until the 1st.

cap.description: A monthly cap on billed new followers; omit or null for none.

groupId.description: The keyword group it belongs to (grp_...); omit for the default group.

handle.description: The handle on the platform, with or without the @; a profile link works too (https://x.com/acme, https://bsky.app/profile/acme.bsky.social).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

platform.description: x, bluesky or github. instagram is refused for now (a 400): its follower list is not readable newest first.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: add_account
title: Add account
